## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor (code improvement that does not add functionality or fix a bug)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have run `make verify` (lockfiles, format, lint, typecheck, unit tests, and both coverage gates) successfully
- [ ] If I could not run a gate locally, I said which one and why (Python 3.12 and 3.13 are both tested in CI; a backend change should be checked on both)
- [ ] I updated `pyproject.toml`/`uv.lock` or `package.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml` in the same change as the manifest, never separately
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable)
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specification (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`)
